title: Gotha II: Tenkuu no Kishi / Teitoku no Ketsudan II
overview:
A not-for-sale demonstration CD-ROM from Koei presenting two of its Sega Saturn strategy titles.

- Gotha II: Tenkuu no Kishi - the sequel to Gotha, a turn-based strategy game built around science fiction aerial combat
- Teitoku no Ketsudan II - a grand strategy game of naval warfare in the Pacific
